visualCharacteristics: Three numbered 'how it works' steps on a light background, each with a large step number (01/02/03), a heading, a description paragraph, and a supporting image. Three columns on desktop.
contentPattern: One row per step. Each row has a body cell (heading + description) and an image cell; the step number is generated automatically from row order.
usage: How-it-works / process explainer sections with sequential numbered steps.
